keyPoints.en: A wave transfers energy from one place to another without transferring matter.
keyPoints.bm: Gelombang memindahkan tenaga dari satu tempat ke tempat lain tanpa memindahkan jirim.

keyPoints.en: Transverse waves vibrate perpendicular to travel (light, water); longitudinal waves vibrate parallel (sound) with compressions and rarefactions.
keyPoints.bm: Gelombang melintang bergetar serenjang (cahaya, air); gelombang membujur bergetar selari (bunyi) dengan mampatan dan regangan.

keyPoints.en: Amplitude A, wavelength λ, period T, frequency f = 1/T.
keyPoints.bm: Amplitud A, panjang gelombang λ, tempoh T, frekuensi f = 1/T.

keyPoints.en: Wave speed v = fλ.
keyPoints.bm: Laju gelombang v = fλ.

keyPoints.en: Displacement–time graphs give T; displacement–distance graphs give λ.
keyPoints.bm: Graf sesaran–masa memberi T; graf sesaran–jarak memberi λ.

question.en: Sound travels at 340 m s⁻¹. Find the wavelength of a 680 Hz note.
question.bm: Bunyi bergerak pada 340 m s⁻¹. Cari panjang gelombang nota 680 Hz.

tip.en: Check the axis label: time axis → period; distance axis → wavelength.
tip.bm: Semak label paksi: paksi masa → tempoh; paksi jarak → panjang gelombang.

keyPoints.en: Damping: amplitude decreases over time because energy is lost (internal and external damping).
keyPoints.bm: Pelembapan: amplitud berkurang kerana tenaga hilang (pelembapan dalam dan luar).

keyPoints.en: A driving force can keep a system oscillating — this is forced oscillation.
keyPoints.bm: Daya luar boleh mengekalkan ayunan sistem — ini ayunan paksa.

keyPoints.en: Resonance: when the driving frequency equals the natural frequency, the amplitude is maximum.
keyPoints.bm: Resonans: apabila frekuensi paksa sama dengan frekuensi asli, amplitud maksimum.

keyPoints.en: Good resonance: tuning radios, musical instruments. Bad resonance: bridges swaying (Tacoma Narrows), glass shattering.
keyPoints.bm: Resonans berguna: menala radio, alat muzik. Resonans berbahaya: jambatan bergoyang (Tacoma Narrows), gelas pecah.

question.en: Why do soldiers break step when marching across a bridge?
question.bm: Mengapa askar memecah langkah semasa berkawad di atas jambatan?

answer.en: To avoid driving the bridge at its natural frequency and causing resonance.
answer.bm: Untuk mengelak memaksa jambatan pada frekuensi aslinya dan menyebabkan resonans.

tip.en: Damping reduces amplitude, but the natural frequency doesn't change.
tip.bm: Pelembapan mengurangkan amplitud, tetapi frekuensi asli tidak berubah.

keyPoints.en: Law of reflection: angle of incidence = angle of reflection (measured from the normal).
keyPoints.bm: Hukum pantulan: sudut tuju = sudut pantulan (diukur dari normal).

keyPoints.en: After reflection, speed, frequency and wavelength are unchanged; only direction changes.
keyPoints.bm: Selepas pantulan, laju, frekuensi dan panjang gelombang tidak berubah; hanya arah berubah.

keyPoints.en: Sound echoes: distance = (speed × time) ÷ 2 because the sound travels there and back.
keyPoints.bm: Gema bunyi: jarak = (laju × masa) ÷ 2 kerana bunyi pergi dan balik.

keyPoints.en: Uses: sonar for ocean depth, ultrasound scans, whispering galleries.
keyPoints.bm: Kegunaan: sonar untuk kedalaman laut, imbasan ultrabunyi, galeri bisikan.

question.en: A sonar pulse returns after 0.4 s. Speed of sound in water = 1500 m s⁻¹. How deep is the seabed?
question.bm: Denyut sonar kembali selepas 0.4 s. Laju bunyi dalam air = 1500 m s⁻¹. Berapa dalam dasar laut?

tip.en: Don't forget to halve the echo time!
tip.bm: Jangan lupa bahagi dua masa gema!

keyPoints.en: Refraction: change of direction when a wave changes speed entering a new medium.
keyPoints.bm: Pembiasan: perubahan arah apabila gelombang berubah laju memasuki medium baharu.

keyPoints.en: Water waves: deep → shallow, speed and λ decrease, wave bends towards the normal. Frequency never changes.
keyPoints.bm: Gelombang air: dalam → cetek, laju dan λ berkurang, gelombang membias ke arah normal. Frekuensi tidak berubah.

keyPoints.en: Ocean waves become parallel to the beach because they slow down in shallow water near the shore.
keyPoints.bm: Ombak menjadi selari dengan pantai kerana ia menjadi perlahan di air cetek berhampiran pantai.

keyPoints.en: Sound refracts too: it is heard further at night because air near the ground is cooler.
keyPoints.bm: Bunyi juga dibiaskan: ia didengar lebih jauh pada waktu malam kerana udara dekat tanah lebih sejuk.

question.en: A wave of λ 3 cm travels at 12 cm s⁻¹ in deep water and 8 cm s⁻¹ in shallow water. Find λ in shallow water.
question.bm: Gelombang λ 3 cm bergerak 12 cm s⁻¹ di air dalam dan 8 cm s⁻¹ di air cetek. Cari λ di air cetek.

tip.en: Find f in the first medium, keep it, then use v = fλ in the second.
tip.bm: Cari f dalam medium pertama, kekalkan, kemudian guna v = fλ dalam medium kedua.

keyPoints.en: Diffraction: waves spread out after passing through a gap or around an obstacle.
keyPoints.bm: Pembelauan: gelombang tersebar selepas melalui celah atau sekitar penghalang.

keyPoints.en: Speed, frequency and wavelength stay the same; amplitude decreases as energy spreads.
keyPoints.bm: Laju, frekuensi dan panjang gelombang kekal; amplitud berkurang kerana tenaga tersebar.

keyPoints.en: Effect is greatest when the gap size is similar to or smaller than the wavelength.
keyPoints.bm: Kesan paling ketara apabila saiz celah hampir sama atau lebih kecil daripada panjang gelombang.

keyPoints.en: Why you can hear someone round a corner but not see them: sound λ (~1 m) diffracts more than light λ (~500 nm).
keyPoints.bm: Mengapa anda boleh dengar orang di sebalik sudut tetapi tidak nampak: λ bunyi (~1 m) lebih terbelau daripada λ cahaya (~500 nm).

question.en: Why are harbour entrances designed carefully?
question.bm: Mengapa pintu masuk pelabuhan direka dengan teliti?

answer.en: A narrow entrance diffracts waves so they spread out and lose amplitude, keeping the harbour calm.
answer.bm: Pintu masuk sempit membelaukan ombak supaya tersebar dan amplitud berkurang, menjadikan pelabuhan tenang.

tip.bm: Celah lebih sempit → lebih banyak penyebaran.

keyPoints.en: Superposition: when waves meet, their displacements add.
keyPoints.bm: Superposisi: apabila gelombang bertemu, sesarannya ditambah.

keyPoints.en: Constructive interference: crest + crest → bigger amplitude (antinode). Destructive: crest + trough → cancel (node).
keyPoints.bm: Interferens membina: puncak + puncak → amplitud lebih besar (antinod). Memusnah: puncak + lembangan → batal (nod).

keyPoints.en: Interference needs coherent sources: same frequency and constant phase difference.
keyPoints.bm: Interferens memerlukan sumber koheren: frekuensi sama dan beza fasa malar.

keyPoints.en: Young's double slit: λ = ax/D (a = slit separation, x = fringe separation, D = slit-to-screen distance).
keyPoints.bm: Dwicelah Young: λ = ax/D (a = jarak celah, x = jarak pinggir, D = jarak celah ke skrin).

question.en: If D is doubled, what happens to the fringe separation x?
question.bm: Jika D digandakan, apa berlaku kepada jarak pinggir x?

answer.en: x = λD/a, so x doubles — fringes spread further apart.
answer.bm: x = λD/a, jadi x berganda — pinggir lebih jauh antara satu sama lain.

tip.en: Convert mm to m before using λ = ax/D.
tip.bm: Tukar mm kepada m sebelum guna λ = ax/D.

keyPoints.en: Electromagnetic waves are transverse, need no medium and travel at 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ in a vacuum.
keyPoints.bm: Gelombang elektromagnet adalah melintang, tidak memerlukan medium dan bergerak pada 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ dalam vakum.

keyPoints.en: Spectrum from long to short λ: radio, microwave, infrared, visible, ultraviolet, X-ray, gamma.
keyPoints.bm: Spektrum dari λ panjang ke pendek: radio, gelombang mikro, inframerah, cahaya nampak, ultraungu, sinar-X, gama.

keyPoints.en: Shorter wavelength = higher frequency = more energy and more harmful.
keyPoints.bm: Panjang gelombang lebih pendek = frekuensi lebih tinggi = tenaga lebih besar dan lebih berbahaya.

keyPoints.en: Uses: radio (broadcasting), microwave (phones, cooking), IR (remote), UV (sterilise), X-ray (bones), gamma (cancer therapy).
keyPoints.bm: Kegunaan: radio (penyiaran), mikro (telefon, memasak), IR (kawalan jauh), UV (sterilkan), sinar-X (tulang), gama (terapi kanser).

question.en: A radio station broadcasts at 100 MHz. Find its wavelength.
question.bm: Stesen radio bersiaran pada 100 MHz. Cari panjang gelombangnya.

tip.en: Mnemonic for the spectrum (long → short): 'Raja Makan Ikan Viral Untuk X-Gamma'.
tip.bm: Mnemonik spektrum (panjang → pendek): 'Raja Makan Ikan Viral Untuk X-Gamma'.
